question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing right midfielder, and Eve is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Claire and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) right winger
(C) cheerleader
(D) right midfielder
(E) left back
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial positions: right back, right winger, cheerleader, right midfielder, left back
1. Eve ↔ Bob: right back, left back, cheerleader, right midfielder, right winger
2. Claire ↔ Eve: right back, left back, right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader
3. Eve ↔ Alice: cheerleader, left back, right winger, right midfielder, right back
4. Dave ↔ Alice: right midfielder, left back, right winger, cheerleader, right back
5. Claire ↔ Bob: right midfielder, right winger, left back, cheerleader, right back
Eve is playing right back, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
